description:
Phone calls: all of EXEDIR/TEL.EXN (game-internals 6m), 680 strings in two blocks. Data area (0xE5F0-0x14F0C, 461 lines reached through pointer lists; repacked with share_identical): girls answering, greetings by mood, yes/no to a date and the goodbyes, cold answers, Ijuin's calls, the stood-up calls, Yoshio's warnings, Miharu's wrong numbers, and the anthology thanks. Code area (0xC430-0xE4F4, 219 strings the code addresses with lui/addiu; they stay in their own slots): Yoshio's call (girl ratings, date spots, girl info card labels), Yumi answering, the invitation the code assembles from fragments (date, place, 'would ... work for you?'), the answering machine and its narration, Tome's fireworks call, the club captain, the date-spot book labels. The code-area fragments are concatenated at run time (strcpy/strcat), so their English is written as pieces: e.g. '4/30, would
Theme Park
work for you?'. Two of the data-area thoughts end in ')' because the Japanese does. Verified in DuckStation from a Saturday state built on the candidate disc: calling Shiori through the date picker, place book, invitation, her yes, the confirmation and the post-call thoughts; calling Yoshio with both menu items, the girl list and Shiori's info card (labels shortened to fit: 'B W H', 'Memo'); calling Ijuin; a missed date's answering-machine message and thoughts; a fresh boot showing Shiori's full name 'S. Fujisaki' (character_names.json) in the phone book. Checked only statically: other girls' calls, a declined date, the cold and stood-up calls, Yoshio's warnings, Miharu, the anthology thanks, Tome and the club captain. The info card values (sign, blood type, notes) are in FUKUTEST/JOHO.NBN and still Japanese.
